$comment: zynkr-ops-weekly PRIVATE runtime config. Copy to ~/.config/zynkr/ops-weekly.json (never commit). Every value below is a placeholder.

space.name: <space display name>
space.$note: The spaces/ prefix is REQUIRED — get_messages rejects a bare id.

doc.$note: Sections are named by MEETING day (Thursday), not by report day (Monday).

chat_ids.$note: The ONLY hardcoded map in this skill. Chat gives no email field at all; the Doc gives email and no id. TWO key forms are valid, because the MCP resolves a sender to a DISPLAY NAME when that person is in the account's personal Contacts and leaves everyone else as users/<id>. Key each person by whichever form their messages actually arrive as -- keeping both is harmless and survives a contact being added later.

non_reporting_members.$note: In the space but deliberately outside the report + chase lists.
